title: WNBA Top-Selling Players, First Half of 2024 (Fanatics)
scope: Player merchandise sales across the Fanatics network during the first half of the 2024 WNBA regular season.
methodology: Fanatics sales data reported by Sports Business Journal and republished by Fanatics. Unit counts are not published.
limitations: This is not an official WNBA list. The league has not published a top-selling jersey list since 2021, so this is the newest ranked list from a major licensed retailer.
The report describes player merchandise in general, not jerseys alone.
Teams shown are current. At the time of the report, Angel Reese played for the Chicago Sky and Kate Martin for the Las Vegas Aces.
periodLabel: First half of the 2024 WNBA season on the Fanatics network (the newest ranked WNBA list)
